parsed.name: Deploy MkDocs site to GitHub Pages

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material

steps.name: Build MkDocs site
steps.run: mkdocs build -f doc-asean/mkdocs.yml

parsed.name: Dev Container Build and Push Image

steps.name: Build image
steps.run: docker build . --file Dockerfile --tag $IMAGE_NAME --label "runnumber=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

steps.name: Log in to registry
steps.run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

steps.name: Push image
steps.run:
IMAGE_ID=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/$IMAGE_NAME

# This changes all uppercase characters to lowercase.
IMAGE_ID=$(echo $IMAGE_ID | tr '[A-Z]' '[a-z]')
# This strips the git ref prefix from the version.
VERSION=latest # $(echo "${{ github.ref }}" | sed -e 's,.*/\(.*\),\1,')
# This strips the "v" prefix from the tag name.
[[ "${{ github.ref }}" == "refs/tags/"* ]] && VERSION=$(echo $VERSION | sed -e 's/^v//')
# This uses the Docker `latest` tag convention.
[ "$VERSION" == "main" ] && VERSION=latest
echo IMAGE_ID=$IMAGE_ID
echo VERSION=$VERSION
docker tag $IMAGE_NAME $IMAGE_ID:$VERSION
docker push $IMAGE_ID:$VERSION

steps.name: Install system dependencies
steps.run: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq graphviz

steps.name: Install doc dependencies
steps.run: pip install -r doc/requirements.txt

steps.name: Build docs (strict)
steps.run: mkdocs build --strict

steps.name: Install interrogate
steps.run: pip install interrogate

steps.name: Check docstring coverage on PR branch

steps.name: Post coverage to step summary
steps.run:
RESULT=$(grep "RESULT:" interrogate-output.txt || echo "RESULT: unknown")
ACTUAL=$(echo "$RESULT" | sed 's/.*actual: \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/')
MINIMUM=$(echo "$RESULT" | sed 's/.*minimum: \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/')

RESULT_MAIN=$(grep "RESULT:" interrogate-main.txt || echo "RESULT: unknown")
MAIN=$(echo "$RESULT_MAIN" | sed 's/.*actual: \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/')

if [ -n "$ACTUAL" ] && [ -n "$MAIN" ]; then
  DELTA=$(awk -v a="$ACTUAL" -v b="$MAIN" 'BEGIN { diff = a - b; printf "%+.1f", diff }')
else
  DELTA="N/A"
fi

if echo "$RESULT" | grep -q "PASSED"; then
  STATUS="✅ PASSED"
else
  STATUS="❌ FAILED"
fi

{
  echo "### Docstring Coverage"
  echo ""
  echo "| | Value |"
  echo "|---|---|"
  echo "| Status | $STATUS |"
  echo "| Coverage (this PR) | ${ACTUAL}% |"
  echo "| Coverage (main) | ${MAIN}% |"
  echo "| Change | ${DELTA}% |"
  echo "| Acceptable Minimum | ${MINIMUM}% |"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

if [ -z "$SUMMARY" ]; then
  ERRORS=0
  FILES=0
  CHECKED=0
  STATUS="✅ No errors"
else
  ERRORS=$(echo "$SUMMARY" | sed 's/Found \([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
  FILES=$(echo "$SUMMARY" | sed 's/.*in \([0-9]*\) file.*/\1/')
  CHECKED=$(echo "$SUMMARY" | sed 's/.*(checked \([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
  STATUS="❌ Errors found"
fi

{
  echo "### Mypy Type Check"
  echo ""
  echo "| | Value |"
  echo "|---|---|"
  echo "| Status | $STATUS |"
  echo "| Errors | ${ERRORS} |"
  echo "| Files with errors | ${FILES} |"
  echo "| Files checked | ${CHECKED:-0} |"
  echo ""
  echo "> Full error details are in Type checking job logs."
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# Add Python import
extract_obj_for_path_py() {
  python - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import sys
from test.utils.extract_ref_objective import extract_obj_for_path
dir, fl = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
print(extract_obj_for_path(dir, fl))
PY
}

# Create properly formatted outputs
clean_csv_cell() {
  local s=$1
  # Add quotes if the field contains a delimiter or a new string
  if [[ "$s" == *\"* || "$s" == *,* || "$s" == *$'\n'* || "$s" == *$'\r'* || "$s" == " "* || "$s" == *" " ]]; then
    # Escape embedded quotes by doubling them
    s=${s//\"/\"\"}
    printf '"%s"' "$s"
  else
    printf '%s' "$s"
  fi
}

# Table is used as a visual part in Actions Summary
TABLE="| Folder | File | Current Objective | Reference Objective |"
TABLE+="\n|:----|:-----|------------------:|--------------------:|"

# Generation of csv files facilitates objective update
CSV_FILE="ref_objectives-${{ matrix.os }}.csv"
CSV_CONTENT="folder,file,objective"

while IFS= read -r line; do
  FILE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
  VALUE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f2-)
  BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE")

  # An enclosing folder contains a name of the run
  FOLDER=$(echo "$FILE" | sed -E 's|.*/logs/([^/]+)/solve_network/.*|\1|')

  if [[ "$FILE" == ./logs/solve_network/* ]]; then
    FOLDER="default"
  fi

  VALUE_RAW=$(awk -v v="$VALUE" 'BEGIN { printf "%.2f\n", v }')
  OBJ_SCALE=1000000
  VALUE_SCALED=$(awk -v v="$VALUE" -v s="$OBJ_SCALE" 'BEGIN { if (s==0) { print "NaN"; exit 1 } printf "%.2f\n", v/s }')

  REF_VALUE=$(extract_obj_for_path_py "$FOLDER" "$BASENAME")

  TABLE+="\n| $FOLDER | $BASENAME | \`$VALUE_SCALED\` | \`$REF_VALUE\` |"
  CSV_CONTENT+=$'\n'"$(clean_csv_cell $FOLDER),$(clean_csv_cell $BASENAME),$(clean_csv_cell $VALUE_RAW)"

done <<< "$OBJ_FOUND"

echo -e "$TABLE"

echo "The output table is formed"

echo "### Objective Results of CI Run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

echo "GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY successfully supplemented with a header"

printf "%b\n" "$TABLE" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

printf "%b" "$CSV_CONTENT" > "$CSV_FILE"

echo "Objective values uploaded to csv"
